WITH sampled AS (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS value) SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM value))::bigint AS epoch_second, (extract(microseconds FROM value)::bigint % 1000000 * 1000)::integer AS nano FROM sampled
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended( 'memory-operation:' || length(#{tenant})::text || ':' || #{tenant} || #{key}, 0 ))::text

SELECT r.tenant_id,r.fact_id,r.revision,r.end_user_id,r.agent_id,r.session_id,r.group_binding_id, r.subject_end_user_id,r.scope,r.type_id,r.status,r.source_session_id,r.created_epoch_second,r.created_nano, r.valid_from_epoch_second,r.valid_from_nano,r.valid_to_epoch_second,r.valid_to_nano, r.expires_epoch_second,r.expires_nano,r.superseded_fact_id,r.content_revision, c.fact_data,c.fact_data_digest,c.extraction_digest,r.recorded_at AS governance_recorded_at FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.fact_id=h.fact_id JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.fact_id=r.fact_id AND c.revision=r.content_revision WHERE h.tenant_id=#{owner.tenantId} AND h.scope=#{owner.scope} AND h.end_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{owner.endUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.agent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{owner.agentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND h.session_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{owner.sessionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND h.group_binding_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{owner.groupBindingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND h.subject_end_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{owner.subjectEndUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND (h.scope<>'SESSION' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources source WHERE source.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND source.fact_id=r.fact_id AND source.revision=r.content_revision AND source.source_target_kind=#{targetKind} AND source.source_target_id=#{targetId})) AND (r.status='FORGOTTEN' OR (r.revision=h.current_revision AND r.status='ARCHIVED' AND r.superseded_fact_id IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY r.fact_id,r.revision

SELECT s.source_target_kind,s.source_target_id,s.source_session_id,s.source_event_id FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources s ON s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND s.fact_id=r.fact_id AND s.revision=r.content_revision WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.fact_id=#{factId} AND r.revision=#{revision} UNION SELECT e.source_target_kind,e.source_target_id,e.source_session_id,e.source_event_id FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_extraction_evidence e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.fact_id=#{factId}

SELECT r.tenant_id,r.fact_id,r.revision,r.end_user_id,r.agent_id,r.session_id,r.group_binding_id,r.subject_end_user_id,r.scope,r.type_id,r.status, r.source_session_id,r.created_epoch_second,r.created_nano,r.valid_from_epoch_second,r.valid_from_nano, r.valid_to_epoch_second,r.valid_to_nano,r.expires_epoch_second,r.expires_nano,r.superseded_fact_id, r.content_revision,c.fact_data,c.fact_data_digest,c.extraction_digest FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.fact_id=h.fact_id AND r.revision=h.current_revision JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.fact_id=r.fact_id AND c.revision=r.content_revision WHERE h.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND h.scope=#{scope} AND (h.scope='SESSION' OR h.end_user_id=#{endUserId}) AND c.extraction_digest=#{digest} AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.superseded_fact_id IS NULL AND (r.created_epoch_second,r.created_nano) <= (#{epoch},#{nano}) AND (r.valid_from_epoch_second,r.valid_from_nano) <= (#{epoch},#{nano}) AND (r.valid_to_epoch_second IS NULL OR (r.valid_to_epoch_second,r.valid_to_nano) > (#{epoch},#{nano})) AND (r.expires_epoch_second IS NULL OR (r.expires_epoch_second,r.expires_nano) > (#{epoch},#{nano})) AND ((h.scope='SESSION' AND h.session_id=#{sessionId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources own_source WHERE own_source.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND own_source.fact_id=h.fact_id AND own_source.revision=r.content_revision AND ((own_source.source_target_kind=#{targetKind} AND own_source.source_target_id=#{targetId}) OR own_source.source_target_kind NOT IN ('AGENT','TEAM','GROUP') OR btrim(own_source.source_target_id)=''))) OR (h.scope='USER_AGENT' AND h.agent_id=#{agentId}) OR (h.scope='USER' AND h.agent_id IS NULL AND h.session_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY r.created_epoch_second,r.created_nano,h.fact_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF h

SELECT r.tenant_id, r.fact_id, r.revision, r.end_user_id, r.agent_id, r.session_id, r.group_binding_id, r.subject_end_user_id, r.scope, r.type_id, r.status, r.source_session_id, r.created_epoch_second, r.created_nano, r.valid_from_epoch_second, r.valid_from_nano, r.valid_to_epoch_second, r.valid_to_nano, r.expires_epoch_second, r.expires_nano, r.superseded_fact_id, r.content_revision,c.fact_data,c.fact_data_digest,c.extraction_digest FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.fact_id=h.fact_id AND r.revision=h.current_revision JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.fact_id=r.fact_id AND c.revision=r.content_revision WHERE h.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND h.fact_id=#{factId} AND ( (h.scope='SESSION' AND h.session_id=#{sessionId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources own_source WHERE own_source.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND own_source.fact_id=h.fact_id AND own_source.revision=r.content_revision AND ((own_source.source_target_kind=#{targetKind} AND own_source.source_target_id=#{targetId}) OR own_source.source_target_kind NOT IN ('AGENT','TEAM','GROUP') OR btrim(own_source.source_target_id)=''))) OR (#{groupBindingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL AND h.end_user_id=#{endUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND (h.scope='USER' OR (h.scope='USER_AGENT' AND h.agent_id=#{agentId}))) OR (h.scope IN ('GROUP','GROUP_MEMBER') AND h.group_binding_id=#{groupBindingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) FOR UPDATE OF h

SELECT r.tenant_id, r.fact_id, r.revision, r.end_user_id, r.agent_id, r.session_id, r.group_binding_id, r.subject_end_user_id, r.scope, r.type_id, r.status, r.source_session_id, r.created_epoch_second, r.created_nano, r.valid_from_epoch_second, r.valid_from_nano, r.valid_to_epoch_second, r.valid_to_nano, r.expires_epoch_second, r.expires_nano, r.superseded_fact_id, r.content_revision,c.fact_data,c.fact_data_digest,c.extraction_digest,q.request_ordinal FROM (VALUES
(#{q.requestOrdinal}::integer,#{q.factId}::text,#{q.endUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}::bigint, #{q.agentId}::text,#{q.sessionId}::text,#{q.groupBindingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::text,#{q.targetKind}::text,#{q.targetId}::text) ) AS q(request_ordinal,fact_id,end_user_id,agent_id,session_id,group_binding_id,target_kind,target_id) JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h ON h.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND h.fact_id=q.fact_id AND ((h.scope='SESSION' AND h.session_id=q.session_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources own_source WHERE own_source.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND own_source.fact_id=h.fact_id AND own_source.revision=1 AND ((own_source.source_target_kind=q.target_kind AND own_source.source_target_id=q.target_id) OR own_source.source_target_kind NOT IN ('AGENT','TEAM','GROUP') OR btrim(own_source.source_target_id)=''))) OR (q.group_binding_id IS NULL AND h.end_user_id=q.end_user_id AND (h.scope='USER' OR (h.scope='USER_AGENT' AND h.agent_id=q.agent_id))) OR (h.scope IN ('GROUP','GROUP_MEMBER') AND h.group_binding_id=q.group_binding_id)) JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.fact_id=h.fact_id AND r.revision=h.current_revision JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.fact_id=r.fact_id AND c.revision=r.content_revision ORDER BY q.request_ordinal

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.fact_id,f.revision,s.source_ordinal,s.agent_id, s.source_target_kind,s.source_target_id,s.source_session_id,s.source_event_id FROM (VALUES
(#{f.factId}::text,#{f.revision}::bigint) ) AS f(fact_id,revision) JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.fact_id=f.fact_id AND r.revision=f.revision JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources s ON s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND s.fact_id=r.fact_id AND s.revision=r.content_revision ORDER BY s.fact_id,f.revision,s.source_ordinal

SELECT r.tenant_id,r.fact_id,r.revision,r.end_user_id,r.agent_id,r.session_id,r.group_binding_id,r.subject_end_user_id,r.scope,r.type_id,r.status,r.source_session_id, r.created_epoch_second,r.created_nano,r.valid_from_epoch_second,r.valid_from_nano,r.valid_to_epoch_second, r.valid_to_nano,r.expires_epoch_second,r.expires_nano,r.superseded_fact_id,r.content_revision,c.fact_data,c.fact_data_digest,c.extraction_digest FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.fact_id=r.fact_id AND c.revision=r.content_revision WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.fact_id=#{factId} AND r.revision=#{revision}
SELECT current_revision FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND fact_id=#{factId} FOR SHARE
SELECT current_revision FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND fact_id=#{factId}

SELECT r.tenant_id, r.fact_id, r.revision, r.end_user_id, r.agent_id, r.session_id, r.group_binding_id, r.subject_end_user_id, r.scope, r.type_id, r.status, r.source_session_id, r.created_epoch_second, r.created_nano, r.valid_from_epoch_second, r.valid_from_nano, r.valid_to_epoch_second, r.valid_to_nano, r.expires_epoch_second, r.expires_nano, r.superseded_fact_id, r.content_revision,c.fact_data,c.fact_data_digest,c.extraction_digest, coalesce(task_link.source_task_linked, false) AS source_task_linked, coalesce(task_link.current_task_linked, false) AS current_task_linked FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.fact_id=h.fact_id AND r.revision=h.current_revision JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.fact_id=r.fact_id AND c.revision=r.content_revision LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) > 0 AS source_task_linked, coalesce(bool_or( task_event.payload_canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{task,taskId}' = cast(#{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS text)), false) AS current_task_linked FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources source_ref JOIN public.agent_runtime_session_events source_event ON source_event.tenant_id=source_ref.tenant_id AND source_event.target_kind=source_ref.source_target_kind AND source_event.target_id=source_ref.source_target_id AND source_event.agent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM source_ref.agent_id AND source_event.session_id=source_ref.source_session_id AND source_event.event_id=source_ref.source_event_id JOIN public.agent_runtime_session_events task_event ON task_event.tenant_id=source_event.tenant_id AND task_event.agent_id=source_event.agent_id AND task_event.session_id=source_event.session_id AND task_event.run_id=source_event.run_id AND task_event.event_type='agent.task-context' AND task_event.payload_schema_id='skillforge.runtime.task-context.v2' WHERE source_ref.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND source_ref.fact_id=h.fact_id AND source_ref.revision=r.content_revision AND source_event.run_id IS NOT NULL AND task_event.payload_canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{task,taskId}' IS NOT NULL ) task_link ON true WHERE h.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND ( (h.scope='SESSION' AND h.session_id=#{sessionId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources own_source WHERE own_source.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND own_source.fact_id=h.fact_id AND own_source.revision=r.content_revision AND ((own_source.source_target_kind=#{targetKind} AND own_source.source_target_id=#{targetId}) OR own_source.source_target_kind NOT IN ('AGENT','TEAM','GROUP') OR btrim(own_source.source_target_id)=''))) OR (#{groupBindingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL AND h.end_user_id=#{endUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND (h.scope='USER' OR (h.scope='USER_AGENT' AND h.agent_id=#{agentId}))) OR (h.scope IN ('GROUP','GROUP_MEMBER') AND h.group_binding_id=#{groupBindingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) AND h.scope IN #{scope} AND (h.scope<>'GROUP_MEMBER' OR h.subject_end_user_id=#{subjectEndUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT})

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.fact_id,r.revision,s.source_ordinal,s.agent_id, s.source_target_kind,s.source_target_id,s.source_session_id,s.source_event_id FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources s ON s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND s.fact_id=r.fact_id AND s.revision=r.content_revision WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.fact_id=#{factId} AND r.revision=#{revision} ORDER BY s.source_ordinal

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_memory_conflict_audits( tenant_id,audit_ref,idempotency_key,fact_id,current_revision,reason_code, command_digest,created_epoch_second,created_nano) VALUES(#{tenant},#{auditRef},#{key},#{factId},#{revision},#{reason},#{digest}, #{recorded.epochSecond},#{recorded.nano}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,audit_ref) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql:
WITH authorized AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT h.fact_id,r.revision,r.content_revision FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.fact_id=h.fact_id AND r.revision=h.current_revision JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.fact_id=r.fact_id AND c.revision=r.content_revision LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) > 0 AS source_task_linked, coalesce(bool_or( task_event.payload_canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{task,taskId}' = cast(#{filter.taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS text)), false) AS current_task_linked FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources source_ref JOIN public.agent_runtime_session_events source_event ON source_event.tenant_id=source_ref.tenant_id AND source_event.target_kind=source_ref.source_target_kind AND source_event.target_id=source_ref.source_target_id AND source_event.agent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM source_ref.agent_id AND source_event.session_id=source_ref.source_session_id AND source_event.event_id=source_ref.source_event_id JOIN public.agent_runtime_session_events task_event ON task_event.tenant_id=source_event.tenant_id AND task_event.agent_id=source_event.agent_id AND task_event.session_id=source_event.session_id AND task_event.run_id=source_event.run_id AND task_event.event_type='agent.task-context' AND task_event.payload_schema_id='skillforge.runtime.task-context.v2' WHERE source_ref.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND source_ref.fact_id=h.fact_id AND source_ref.revision=r.content_revision AND source_event.run_id IS NOT NULL AND task_event.payload_canonical_json::jsonb #>> '{task,taskId}' IS NOT NULL ) task_link ON true WHERE h.tenant_id=#{filter.tenant} AND ( (h.scope='SESSION' AND h.session_id=#{filter.sessionId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources own_source WHERE own_source.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND own_source.fact_id=h.fact_id AND own_source.revision=r.content_revision AND ((own_source.source_target_kind=#{filter.targetKind} AND own_source.source_target_id=#{filter.targetId}) OR own_source.source_target_kind NOT IN ('AGENT','TEAM','GROUP') OR btrim(own_source.source_target_id)=''))) OR (#{filter.groupBindingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL AND h.end_user_id=#{filter.endUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND (h.scope='USER' OR (h.scope='USER_AGENT' AND h.agent_id=#{filter.agentId}))) OR (h.scope IN ('GROUP','GROUP_MEMBER') AND h.group_binding_id=#{filter.groupBindingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) AND h.scope IN #{scope} AND (h.scope<>'GROUP_MEMBER' OR h.subject_end_user_id=#{filter.subjectEndUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.superseded_fact_id IS NULL AND (r.created_epoch_second,r.created_nano)<=(#{filter.evaluatedSecond},#{filter.evaluatedNano}) AND (r.valid_from_epoch_second,r.valid_from_nano)<=(#{filter.asOfSecond},#{filter.asOfNano}) AND (r.valid_to_epoch_second IS NULL OR (r.valid_to_epoch_second,r.valid_to_nano)>(#{filter.asOfSecond},#{filter.asOfNano})) AND (r.expires_epoch_second IS NULL OR (r.expires_epoch_second,r.expires_nano)>(#{filter.asOfSecond},#{filter.asOfNano})) AND (NOT #{filter.recent} OR (r.valid_from_epoch_second,r.valid_from_nano)>=(#{filter.recentAfterSecond},#{filter.recentAfterNano})) AND ((NOT #{filter.recent} AND #{filter.taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR NOT coalesce(task_link.source_task_linked,false) OR coalesce(task_link.current_task_linked,false)) AND h.type_id IN #{type} )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_memory_embeddings(tenant_id,fact_id,content_revision,projection_version,analyzer_version,model_id,model_revision,dimensions,text_digest,invocation_id) VALUES(#{document.tenantId},#{document.factId},#{document.contentRevision},#{document.projectionVersion},#{document.analyzerVersion},#{model.modelConfigId},#{model.revision},#{model.dimensions},#{document.textDigest},#{invocationId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public.agent_runtime_memory_embeddings SET state='UNKNOWN',reason_code='memory_embedding_outcome_unknown',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: WITH pending AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.tenant_id,e.invocation_id FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_embeddings e JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h ON h.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND h.fact_id=e.fact_id JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.fact_id=h.fact_id AND r.revision=h.current_revision WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.state='QUEUED' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.superseded_fact_id IS NULL AND (r.valid_from_epoch_second+r.valid_from_nano/1000000000.0)<=extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) AND (r.valid_to_epoch_second IS NULL OR (r.valid_to_epoch_second+r.valid_to_nano/1000000000.0)>extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())) AND (r.expires_epoch_second IS NULL OR (r.expires_epoch_second+r.expires_nano/1000000000.0)>extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())) ORDER BY e.updated_at,e.fact_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF e SKIP LOCKED), claimed AS ( UPDATE public.agent_runtime_memory_embeddings e SET state='RUNNING',lease_token=#{token},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+#{leaseSeconds}*interval '1 second',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM pending p WHERE e.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND e.invocation_id=p.invocation_id RETURNING e.tenant_id,e.fact_id,e.content_revision,e.projection_version,e.analyzer_version, e.model_id,e.model_revision,e.dimensions,e.text_digest,e.invocation_id,e.state,e.embedding, e.lease_token,e.lease_until,e.reason_code) SELECT c.tenant_id,c.fact_id,c.content_revision,c.projection_version,c.analyzer_version, c.model_id,c.model_revision,c.dimensions,c.text_digest,c.invocation_id,c.state,c.lease_token, c.lease_until,c.reason_code,c.embedding::text vector_text,d.search_text,d.run_data,d.identity_data FROM claimed c JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_search_documents d USING(tenant_id,fact_id,content_revision,projection_version,analyzer_version)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_memory_query_embeddings(tenant_id,operation_id,fingerprint,invocation_id,model_id,model_revision,dimensions,run_data,identity_data,state,deadline_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{operation},#{fingerprint},#{invocation},#{model.modelConfigId},#{model.revision},#{model.dimensions},#{runData},#{identityData},'RUNNING',#{deadline}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

mapper.update: UPDATE public.agent_runtime_memory_query_embeddings SET state='UNKNOWN',reason_code='memory_query_embedding_outcome_unknown' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{operation} AND state='RUNNING' AND deadline_at<=clock_timestamp()

UPDATE public.agent_runtime_memory_query_embeddings SET state=#{state},embedding=CAST(#{vector,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS vector),reason_code=#{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{operation} AND fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND state='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.fact_id=h.fact_id AND r.revision=h.current_revision WHERE h.tenant_id=#{work.tenantId.value} AND h.fact_id=#{work.factId} AND r.content_revision=#{work.contentRevision} AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.superseded_fact_id IS NULL AND (r.valid_from_epoch_second+r.valid_from_nano/1000000000.0)<=extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) AND (r.valid_to_epoch_second IS NULL OR (r.valid_to_epoch_second+r.valid_to_nano/1000000000.0)>extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())) AND (r.expires_epoch_second IS NULL OR (r.expires_epoch_second+r.expires_nano/1000000000.0)>extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())))

SELECT h.fact_id,r.revision,original.run_data,original.identity_data,operation.command_data FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h JOIN public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.fact_id=h.fact_id AND r.revision=h.current_revision LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT run_data,identity_data FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_search_documents d WHERE d.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND d.fact_id=h.fact_id AND d.content_revision=r.content_revision ORDER BY projection_version,analyzer_version LIMIT 1) original ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT o.command_data FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_operations o WHERE o.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND o.result_fact_id=h.fact_id AND o.result_revision=1 AND o.command_kind IN ('CREATE','SUPERSEDE') LIMIT 1) operation ON true WHERE h.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.status IN ('ACTIVE','PENDING_CONFIRM') AND r.superseded_fact_id IS NULL AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_search_documents d WHERE d.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND d.fact_id=h.fact_id AND d.content_revision=r.content_revision AND d.projection_version=#{policy.projectionVersion} AND d.analyzer_version=#{policy.analyzerVersion}) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_memory_embeddings e WHERE e.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND e.fact_id=h.fact_id AND e.content_revision=r.content_revision AND e.projection_version=#{policy.projectionVersion} AND e.analyzer_version=#{policy.analyzerVersion} AND e.model_id=#{model.modelConfigId} AND e.model_revision=#{model.revision} AND e.dimensions=#{model.dimensions})) ORDER BY h.fact_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR SHARE OF h
